title: Helium was discovered on the Sun before it was found on Earth
body: During a total solar eclipse in August 1868, astronomers studying the Sun’s glowing outer layers with spectroscopes spotted a bright yellow line that didn’t match any known element. Norman Lockyer proposed it came from a new element and named it after Helios, the Greek word for the Sun. Helium wasn’t isolated on Earth until 1895, when William Ramsay and others found it seeping from a uranium mineral. It is now known to be the second most abundant element in the universe.
